title: Bones and Reapers
notes: NEW: two Yomi-only gear sets. Hollow Bone (Circles 1-4, Yomi Arena 1-5): +15% HP, -4% damage taken / +20% ATK, +45% Crit DMG. Shinigami (Circles 5-9, Yomi Arena 6-10): +16% ATK, +5% Crit Rate / +30% Skill DMG, +50% Crit DMG, +40% Spirit DMG.
Yomi drops are never Common; about a third of Yomi drops are set pieces.
